propositions: The bedrock_model_id field and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID env var are populated but read by no consumer.
An operator setting REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID gets silent no-ops: no model change, warning, or error.
The Bedrock model id is actually carried by cfg.model as a provider-prefixed 'bedrock:<id>' string parsed by providers.py.
The fix deletes the inert field, its from_env wiring, docstring lines, docs row, and duplicated literal comment.
DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID in bedrock_model.py stays as the sole live default definition.
A regression test asserts LLMConfig.from_env() exposes no bedrock_model_id attribute while the working REBAR_LLM_MODEL=bedrock:<id> path still resolves.
